concepts.description: Formal Tolkāppiyam rules that define or classify letters, dependent signs, phonological categories, articulation, or closely related letter-system structure. This is grammatical concept evidence, not a historical technology claim.

Formal Tolkāppiyam evidence that places a grammatical or phonological phenomenon specifically in an இசை/music context. It does not by itself establish a historical performance event, performer, instrument, or social practice.

Formal Tolkāppiyam reference to another textual, scholarly, or disciplinary tradition. Exact source wording is retained; the concept does not resolve the reference to a particular external work unless the source itself establishes that identity.
